title: Preferring to stay home versus working on the road
summary: He would rather stay in New Orleans if the money matched the road, and does not want to work every night at his age; the talk drifts to the interviewer's age.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Where do you like to play the most? Which city? New Orleans? Well I don't know.
I'd rather be home I think. If I could make the money that I get on the road here I'd prefer staying here.

You can just get the union skills. Of course the Japanese is very nice. He plays a little better in the union skills. I don't think I'd want to work every night at this age. I think I could live without it. Not as well as you and your dad and your mama. Because you're not mine, huh? No. But you ain't got nothing to worry about. Not yet? No. You've got a nice mother, nice daddy. How old are you? Twenty-five.
